Container.Name: ao3-archive
Container.Overview: Search, read and download the EPUBs inside the AO3 "things" archive (105 zip files, about 746 GiB) without extracting them. On first start it indexes every zip into one SQLite file in the Index folder (about 30 GB for 20 million works; several hours, resumable). Search by title, author, fandom or tag, read chapters in the browser, and download the original .epub.[br][br]Two ways to provide the zips:[br]1. Download the torrent to a share and set Data folder to it.[br]2. Add the magnet to Real-Debrid and fill in Real-Debrid username and WebDAV password; rclone inside the container then mounts dav.real-debrid.com and the zips are read over your internet connection. Leave Data folder empty in that case. The Extra Parameters (SYS_ADMIN, /dev/fuse) are required for this.[br][br]Index folder: where ao3.db is written. Put it on a share with room for about 35 GB.[br][br]Keep this on your LAN. It has no login.
Container.Requires: The "things" torrent, either downloaded to a share or added to a Real-Debrid account.

Config.Name: Data folder (torrent zips)
Config.Description: Folder holding queue01.zip ... queue94.zip and the other zips, if you downloaded the torrent locally. Leave EMPTY when using Real-Debrid. Read-only.

Config.Name: Index folder
Config.Description: Where the search index ao3.db is stored (about 30 GB for 20M works, about 35 GB with summary search). Use a disk share instead of appdata if your cache pool is small.

Config.Name: Real-Debrid username
Config.Description: Your Real-Debrid username. Leave empty if the zips are in the Data folder.

Config.Name: Real-Debrid WebDAV password
Config.Description: The WebDAV password shown on your Real-Debrid account page (it is NOT your login password and not the API token).

Config.Name: WebDAV folder
Config.Description: Folder on the WebDAV share that holds the zips. Real-Debrid puts each torrent under torrents/<torrent name>.

Config.Name: WebDAV URL
Config.Description: WebDAV server. Change only for a service other than Real-Debrid.

Config.Name: rclone remote (advanced)
Config.Description: Instead of the WebDAV fields: a remote:path from your own rclone.conf, mapped into the container at /config/rclone.conf.

Config.Name: rclone config folder (advanced)
Config.Description: Folder holding rclone.conf when using your own rclone remote.

Config.Name: Extra rclone flags (advanced)
Config.Description: Extra flags appended to rclone mount, e.g. --tpslimit 4.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the index files. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the index files. 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask for the index files.

Config.Name: Index workers
Config.Description: How many CPU threads parse EPUBs while indexing. 0 uses all of them. Lower it to keep the server responsive.

Config.Name: Searchable summaries
Config.Description: true makes summaries searchable (index about 20% larger). Only applies when the index is first created.

Config.Name: Index on start
Config.Description: Index new or unfinished zips in the background whenever the container starts.
